notes.title: NEW UPDATE; VERSION 0.110
notes.notes:
Our game has been updated to version 0.110 Update content;
-A short training section has been added to the beginning of the game explaining how it is played.
-Ritual bugs are fixed.
-Item spawn locations and quantities have been increased.
-Fixed bugs during demon attack.
-New duty added.
-Some minor bugs fixed.

notes.title: October 25 update notes
notes.notes:
A character walk was fixed.
The artificial intelligence of the beast has been improved.
New sounds added.
Some minor bugs fixed.

notes.title: First bug update
notes.notes:
Multiplayer connection problems fixed.
Door and item spawn problems fixed.
Brightness settings added and ambient lighting made better.
And other minor bugs fixed.
